# aviorstudio.github.io

Static redirect to [Avior Studio](https://www.avior.studio/).

Install the [Komizo release](https://github.com/nicodes/komizo#install) matching `komizo.lock`, then run `komizo check`. Use `komizo describe` to inspect the applicable stages.
